theorems.name: Submission.adr_weak_tendsto_of_tendstoUniformly
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (g : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μ) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g x ∂μ))) → IsCompact K → (∀ k, Continuous (hs k)) → Continuous h → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ x ∉ K, hs k x = 0) → (∀ x ∉ K, h x = 0) → TendstoUniformly hs h atTop → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, hs k x • gs k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, h x • g x ∂μ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
